Hi Kenji — thanks for flagging this, and good catch on the UTC label. Short answer: we expect 15:00 JST (same-day). The calendar invite we sent apparently had the event time stored in UTC but the description pulled local times inconsistently, which can flip the date for Sydney attendees (AEDT/AEST difference + daylight savings).

I double-checked: 15:00 JST = 14:00 SGT = 16:00 AEDT (if Sydney is on DST). Could you tell me which timezone Tom is on (Sydney currently observing DST or not)? I want to avoid any next-day surprises.

I'm looping in Monica to send an updated invite that explicitly lists all three local times in the title and sets the RSVP window to the correct date.

Cheers,
Rishi
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
